task: Execute the full Capstone 2 to Capstone 3 progression workflow: post-defense manuscript revision submission (v2), Action Done Matrix (ADM) action documentation, panel fulfillment verification checkboxes, adviser manuscript approval, secretary compliance verification endorsement, multi-signatory digital signatures, and deterministic automatic progression into Capstone 3 with celebratory clearance banner, interactive Gantt chart, system development roadmap, and chapter submissions.
key_decisions: Automatic Progression Trigger: In server/modules/projects/project.controller.js, checkAndAdvancePhaseIfADMCompleted inspects if isSecretaryDone, isAdviserDone, and isChairDone are true. If project.capstonePhase === 2, it automatically sets capstonePhase = 3, capstoneCourse = 'Capstone 3', admStatus = 'approved', dispatches team notifications, and broadcasts WebSocket events.

Panel Fulfillment Verification Checkbox: Added an interactive checkbox to Column 3 of ActionDoneMatrixTab ([✓] Fulfilled & Verified by Panel) gated for committee members to verify student actions taken with persistent status 'verified'.

Revised Manuscript Approval Distinction: In ProjectDetailPage.jsx, handleEndorseProposal and manuscript card buttons dynamically adjust when version > 1 to render 'Approve Revised Manuscript' and 'v{version} Revision Approved' badge.
Celebratory Capstone 2 Clearance Banner: Rendered in capstone_3 tab announcing Phase 3 Active and unlocking the Interactive Gantt Chart, System Development Roadmap, and Chapters 4–5 submissions.
